_note: Remote-backend (proxy) example for SonicMaster. SonicMaster is NOT pip-installable and pins torch==2.4.0 (which failed to resolve in the build) plus a gated VAE (stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0). Instead of installing any of that, this thin frontend installs ONLY pyharp + gradio + gradio_client and forwards inference to the authors' official Space (amaai-lab/SonicMaster) over gradio_client -- so the heavy deps, the gated weights, and ZeroGPU all stay on the backend. The official Space's callback is `enhance_audio_ui(audio_path, prompt)` bound via run_btn.click with no explicit api_name, so Gradio auto-names it after the function. CONFIRM the exact api_name/signature against the live Space with `python -m tools.model_agent scaffold-remote-recipe amaai-lab/SonicMaster` (it auto-picks the sole endpoint), then point framework.remote.space at your own duplicate if you need API stability / your own quota.

model.name: SonicMaster
model.description: Text-controlled all-in-one music restoration and mastering (fix reverb, clipping, EQ/tonal balance, dynamics, and stereo image) from a natural-language instruction. This is a thin HARP frontend that proxies to the authors' official SonicMaster Gradio Space via gradio_client, so none of its heavy/gated dependencies (torch, diffusers, the gated stable-audio VAE) are installed here.
model.author: AMAAI-Lab

inputs.name: input_audio
inputs.label: Input audio
inputs.info: The music/audio to restore or master.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Instruction
inputs.info: Natural-language edit, e.g. 'reduce reverb and brighten the vocals', 'make it louder', 'dereverb', 'widen the stereo image'. Leave as-is for general restoration.

outputs.name: output_audio
outputs.label: Enhanced audio
outputs.info: SonicMaster output returned by the backend Space.
